title: Ref
description: The only edge. Carried by a fact. INTERNAL kinds are exactly fact|slot|subject; every other kind is EXTERNAL and has freshness (rev, snapshot, snapshot_hash, etag, verified_at, valid). For kind=slot, target is "<subjectIdOrName>#<key>". kind=symbol is EXTERNAL and names a symbol in an external analysis: target is "<qualified-name>@<revision>" (e.g. django.db.models.QuerySet.filter@e4f3fb2d2d11); the qualified name may contain dots, colons and parentheses, the revision is everything after the LAST @ and must be non-empty, otherwise the write is rejected with symbol_target_requires_revision. A symbol ref is never resolved to a node and adds no internal edge. basis=observed is a runtime or human observation; basis=derived is a citation of an analyzer's output, not an assertion of the referencing fact. If an observation disagrees with the analysis, post it with rel=refutes against the symbol ref. Effective chain confidence = MIN over refs.

kind.description: Open string. fact|slot|subject are internal; all others external.

target.description: kind=slot: "<subjectIdOrName>#<key>"; kind=symbol: "<qualified-name>@<revision>" (revision required); otherwise an opaque normalized string.
